title: Compute drift velocity vs electric field
action: Implement the displaced‑Maxwellian transport equations for the two-valley model with spherical nonparabolic band structure. Solve the momentum and energy balance equations for electric fields from 0 to at least 50 kV/cm to obtain the drift velocity for both parabolic (ε₀=∞) and nonparabolic (ε₀=1.8 eV) cases. Output the curves as CSV.
description: CSV file with columns: field_kV_per_cm, v_parabolic (cm/s), v_nonparabolic (cm/s). Electric field range 0 to at least 50 kV/cm with resolution fine enough to resolve peak and valley.

title: Extract characteristic quantities
action: From the computed v(E) curves and the valley populations tracked during the simulation, extract: (a) threshold field (kV/cm) – location of peak velocity, (b) valley field (kV/cm) – location of minimum velocity after peak, (c) zero-field mobility (cm²/V·s) – low-field slope v/E, (d) maximum negative differential mobility (cm²/V·s) – most negative dv/dE expressed as mobility, (e) population ratio of (100) valleys at 2 kV/cm (%). Output a JSON file with ten numeric fields.
description: JSON object with ten numeric fields: the five quantities above for both parabolic and nonparabolic cases.
output_schema: Keys: parabolic_threshold_field_kV_per_cm, nonparabolic_threshold_field_kV_per_cm, parabolic_valley_field_kV_per_cm, nonparabolic_valley_field_kV_per_cm, parabolic_zero_field_mobility_cm2_per_Vs, nonparabolic_zero_field_mobility_cm2_per_Vs, parabolic_max_NDM_cm2_per_Vs, nonparabolic_max_NDM_cm2_per_Vs, parabolic_population_ratio_2kV_per_cm_pct, nonparabolic_population_ratio_2kV_per_cm_pct
